question: A mechanism that can split the power of a propeller shaft to the rear axle and produce variation in the speed of rear wheels when the vehicle takes a turn is called a/an:
solution:
The correct answer is __Differential Unit**(Option 2)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A Differential Unit__ is a critical component in vehicles.
 
• It splits the power from the propeller shaft to the rear axle.
 
• It allows the rear wheels to rotate at different speeds when the vehicle takes a turn.
 
• This mechanism ensures smooth and stable cornering.
 
• Without a differential, tires would experience excessive wear due to the difference in wheel rotation speeds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Automatic Clutch Unit:**

 
 
• It is used to engage and disengage the clutch automatically without manual effort.
 
• It helps in smooth gear shifting.
 
 
 
• **Torque Converter:**
 
 
• A torque converter is a type of fluid coupling used in automatic transmissions.
 
• It transfers rotating power from the engine to the transmission.
 
 
 
• **Integral Unit:**
 
 
• It refers to components integrated into a single unit for compactness and efficiency.
 
• Commonly used in modern vehicle designs.
